comment: frozen-graph harness journey — runs against a PRE-SEEDED scenario (graph already in scenarios.graph). No draft/target turns. FA0 run_analysis is deterministic (resolveSeed); then confidence-boundary + coaching probes. Every arm hits the identical analysed state → prompt is the only variable. TURN IDS ARE F-PREFIXED (FA0/FE1/FT10/FT19/FP23/FP25) DELIBERATELY: results aggregate by turn id, and a bare T19/P23 would silently collide with round-1/hardening journeys' T19/P23 (which ask differently worded questions), corrupting cross-round comparisons. Keep frozen ids F-prefixed; never reuse a plain T##/P## id from another journey.
